metadata.source: 14 CFR 93.350-93.353 (SFRA Hudson/East River Exclusions); real shoreline from OpenStreetMap contributors via Overpass API, ODbL 1.0 (geo/fetch_water.py)
metadata.approximate_note: Each feature's own approximate_note gives the detail; in short, the real OSM water polygons cover most of each river (see geo/check.py acceptance numbers), with hand-buffered approximate extensions only at the far north/south ends and a latitude-line approximation for the LGA VOR/DME 6 nm arc crossing and the regulatory north/south cutoffs.

properties.name: Hudson River Exclusion (SFRA)
properties.direction_rule: southbound on west shoreline, northbound on east shoreline, 1,000 ft MSL or higher, self-announce at charted reporting points
properties.source: 14 CFR 93.350(d)/93.351/93.352 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-14/chapter-I/subchapter-F/part-93/subpart-W); Class B floor 1,300 ft MSL per FR Doc 2026-15552 (NY Class B Area K); shoreline from OpenStreetMap contributors (relations 2389611, 2389521), ODbL 1.0 (see geo/fetch_water.py, geo/SOURCES.md)
properties.approximate_note: Shoreline is REAL (OSM tidal-water relations 2389611/2389521, ODbL) for roughly 40.707N-40.884N, which covers the Midtown/UWS/GWB stretch. North of 40.884N (toward Alpine Tower) and south of 40.707N (toward the Verrazzano-Narrows area and the 93.350(c)/(d) shared vertex), the Overpass API did not yield a real polygon in the time available, so those two extensions are a hand-centerline buffer (+-0.45 nm), approximate. The north/south regulatory cutoff itself is also a latitude line, not the exact Colts Neck-radial/Verrazzano cutline.

properties.name: East River Exclusion, Governors Island to LGA VOR/DME 6 nm arc
properties.direction_rule: airplanes need ATC authorization (93.353); helicopters self-announce
properties.source: 14 CFR 93.350(c) (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-14/chapter-I/subchapter-F/part-93/subpart-W); shoreline from OpenStreetMap contributors (relation 2389633), ODbL 1.0
properties.approximate_note: Shoreline is REAL (OSM tidal-water relation 2389633, ODbL) for roughly 40.688N-40.735N. South of 40.688N, toward the sourced 93.350(c) start vertex (40-38-39N/74-02-03W), is a hand-centerline buffer (+-0.3 nm), approximate (Overpass did not yield a real polygon there in the time available). The LGA VOR/DME 6 nm arc crossing is approximated as a latitude cut (40.735N), not a true circle/polygon intersection.

properties.name: East River Exclusion, LGA VOR/DME 6 nm arc to north tip Roosevelt Island
properties.direction_rule: airplanes need ATC authorization (93.353); helicopters self-announce
properties.source: 14 CFR 93.350(c) (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-14/chapter-I/subchapter-F/part-93/subpart-W); shoreline from OpenStreetMap contributors (relations 2389563 West Channel, 2389581 East Channel, 20805948), ODbL 1.0
properties.approximate_note: Shoreline is REAL (OSM tidal-water relations around Roosevelt Island and north to ~40.798N, ODbL). North endpoint (Roosevelt Island north tip, ~40.7714N) is named in the regulation and sits inside this real-data range. The 6 nm arc crossing is approximated as in the south band (latitude cut at 40.735N).
